name: LeaveBalance
description: Current leave balance for each employee by leave type

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the leave balance record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this leave balance

fields.name: leaveTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of leave (vacation, sick, personal, etc.)

fields.name: totalAllotted
fields.description: Total number of leave days allotted for the period

fields.name: used
fields.description: Number of leave days already used

fields.name: available
fields.description: Number of leave days currently available (totalAllotted - used)

fields.name: periodStartDate
fields.description: Start date of the leave balance period

fields.name: periodEndDate
fields.description: End date of the leave balance period

relationships.description: Each leave balance belongs to one employee
Each leave balance is associated with one leave type

indexes.description: Ensure one balance record per employee per leave type per period
Quick lookup of all leave balances for an employee

constraints.uniqueEmployeeLeaveType: An employee can have only one balance record per leave type per period
constraints.availableCalculation: Available balance must equal totalAllotted minus used
